meta.title: Australia - Jervis Bay, Port Stephens & Sydney 2027
meta.dates: Dec 16, 2027 – Jan 2, 2028 (MIA → LAX → Sydney Dec 16 · Jervis Bay → Port Stephens → Sydney for NYE · fly home Jan 2)

route.name: Port Stephens
route.sub: 5 nights · Oaks Pacific Blue or the Anchorage

blocks.title: Arrive MIA, check bags
blocks.detail:
3 hrs ahead for an international itinerary with a family of 4.
3 checked bags + 1 carry-on + 3 backpacks — tag the carry-on for the long leg.
Swimsuits, sun shirts and hats in the backpacks: landing day goes to the beach.

blocks.title: American Airlines AA2290 - MIA → LAX - Nonstop - 5h31m
blocks.detail:
MIA → LAX, Economy, 4 passengers, Airbus A321neo.
Lands 8:46 PM Pacific.
blocks.notes: • First leg of one connecting itinerary; points and cash for the whole trip are logged on the LAX → SYD leg.

blocks.title: Change planes at LAX
blocks.detail: 2h 9m connection. Last real food before the 15-hour leg — eat here.
blocks.notes: • ~$60 for the family in the terminal.

blocks.title: American Airlines AA73 - LAX → SYD - Nonstop - 15h10m
blocks.detail:
LAX → SYD, Economy, 4 passengers, Boeing 777-300ER.
Crosses the International Date Line — Friday Dec 17 disappears in flight.
Lands 7:05 AM Saturday Dec 18, Sydney time (AEDT, UTC+11, 16 hrs ahead of Miami).
Total itinerary 22h 50m.
blocks.flag: Apply for each traveller's Australian ETA (official 'Australian ETA' app) before departure — not issued on arrival.
blocks.notes:
• Alaska Atmos Rewards: 65,000 pts + $48 per person → 260,000 pts + $192 for four.
• Schedule from a real AA search of this routing; confirm the Dec 16, 2027 times when award inventory opens (~Dec 2026–Jan 2027).
• Board at 11 PM Pacific, land at 7 AM Sydney — sleep as much as possible on board.

days.title: Land Sydney → Cronulla brunch on the beach → straight to Jervis Bay

blocks.title: Land SYD T1, taxi to the gate, deplane
blocks.detail: Wheels-down to doors-open is ~20 min on a 777 in the 7 AM arrival wave. A family of four isn't off first.

blocks.title: Immigration, bags, biosecurity — 90 min
blocks.detail:
SmartGate for the adults' US e-passports; the kids go through the staffed lane with a parent.
Bags off a 777 take 25–40 min to reach the carousel.
Biosecurity: declare any food — no snacks or fruit off the plane.
Reported SYD mornings: 30–40 min on a good day, up to 1.5–2 hrs in the 6–9 AM wave when several widebodies land together. 90 min is the honest planning figure for four people and three bags.

blocks.title: Bathroom stop, eSIM check, walk to the rental desks
blocks.detail: Rental counters are in the T1 arrivals hall; the cars are in the T1 carpark a few minutes' walk away.

blocks.title: Rental car pickup — Sydney Airport T1 (10 days)
blocks.detail:
LARGE SUV or people-mover, not a mid-size: 3 checked bags + a carry-on + 3 backpacks don't fit behind the second row of a RAV4-class car with four people in it.
Book the 'Full-size / Large SUV' class — Toyota Kluger (Highlander), Kia Sorento, Hyundai Santa Fe, Ford Everest — or the Kia Carnival people-mover, which takes all of it with room to spare.
One booster for the 6-year-old (NSW: under 7 in an approved restraint; the 8-year-old may use the adult belt).
50 min: holiday-week queue, paperwork, fitting the booster, loading, finding the exit. Drive on the left.
blocks.flag: Book now on a free-cancellation rate — large SUVs and Carnivals are the first class to sell out at SYD over Christmas. Confirm the boot takes 3 large checked bags with the third row folded.
blocks.notes:
COST (estimate):
• Sat Dec 18 9:10 AM → Tue Dec 28 ~noon in Sydney = 10 rental days (no car during the Sydney stay).
• Aggregator averages for Sydney SUVs: ~USD 51/day overall, ~USD 61/day in December (the peak month), full-size class USD 52–66/day — roughly AUD 80–100/day off-peak.
• Christmas week from a major brand at T1 (Hertz/Avis/Budget/Europcar/Sixt) for a Kluger/Carnival class: AUD 140–180/day → modeled at AUD 160 × 10 = AUD 1,600.
• + booster ~AUD 50 + Sydney motorway tolls ~AUD 50 ≈ AUD 1,700 ≈ USD 1,105.
• Re-quote ~6 months out; Dec 2027 rates aren't open yet.

blocks.title: Drive SYD T1 → North Cronulla
blocks.detail:
General Holmes Dr → Captain Cook Bridge → Taren Point → Cronulla. ~20 km, 25 min; 30 allowed for the first drive on the left.
Cronulla is Sydney's only beach suburb south of the airport — 10 min off the route into the Royal National Park, not a detour.
Park in the North Cronulla beachfront / Kingsway parking (metered).

blocks.title: First meal in Australia — Next Door, North Cronulla beach (brunch)
blocks.detail:
Beachside café-restaurant at 4–6 Kingsway, on North Cronulla beach with the ocean in front of the outdoor tables — the view you want for the first meal, without harbour-restaurant prices.
Open from 6:30 AM Saturdays; all-day breakfast (jalapeño corn fritters, chilli scrambled eggs, eggs benedict, French-toast brûlée) plus lunch plates and burgers. Kid-friendly.
Local chef, open since 2016 — a Shire institution rather than a tourist spot.
Walk the 50 m onto the sand after: the kids' first Australian beach, 3½ hours after landing.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE — menu online, prices not published (reviewers: 'reasonable for the area', $$–$$$):
• 2 adult brunch mains ~AUD 28 each (Sydney beachside café range AUD 24–32)
• 2 kids' plates ~AUD 14 each
• = AUD ~84 ≈ USD 55.
• Backup with the same view, cheaper and more kiosk-like: Bianchini's Elouera, 5 min up the beach at Elouera Beach (all-day breakfast).
• Zimzala, the old Rydges beachfront restaurant, no longer operates.

blocks.title: Walk on North Cronulla beach, back to the car
blocks.detail:
• From: Next Door → across the Kingsway promenade onto North Cronulla Beach (50 m).
• Feet in the water, then back to the car in the Kingsway beachfront parking.
• Bathroom stop before the 2-hour drive.

blocks.title: Drive North Cronulla → Huskisson (direct)
blocks.detail:
• Kingsway → Princes Hwy (Sutherland) → M1 Princes Motorway south past Wollongong → Princes Hwy through Kiama, the Berry bypass and Nowra → left onto Jervis Bay Rd (Falls Creek) → Huskisson Rd → Owen St.
• ~170 km; ~1h50 driving + a 10-min bathroom stop — estimated. Holiday-Saturday traffic at Nowra can add 15 min.
• Bathroom stop: Kiama Blowhole car park (public toilets open at all times, ~5 min off the highway) or Berry.
• To: Jervis Bay Motel, 41 Owen St (free on-site parking).
• The scenic Grand Pacific Drive (Royal NP, Bald Hill, Sea Cliff Bridge) moves to a later driving day.
blocks.flag: Driver fatigue: you land after an overnight economy flight — swap drivers at the bathroom stop.

blocks.title: Check in — Jervis Bay Motel, Deluxe Family Room (5 nights)
blocks.detail:
• 41 Owen St, Huskisson — a 2–3 min walk to the beach at Huskisson Whitesands Park.
• Deluxe Family Room: king bed + a separate bedroom with 2 single beds, kitchenette (microwave, toaster, bar fridge), ensuite, glimpses of Jervis Bay. Sleeps 4.
• Check-in from 2 PM (earlier only if a room is free); check-out 10 AM. Reception open 9:30 AM–5 PM Saturdays.
blocks.roomType: Deluxe Family Room (king + separate room with 2 singles)
blocks.notes:
PRICED FOR THESE EXACT DATES (checked Nov 6, 2026):
• Hotel website (RMS booking engine), 2 adults + 2 children, Dec 18–23, 2027: AUD 2,256.30 total (AUD 451.26 avg/night) ≈ USD 1,467.
• Booking.com, same room: AUD 2,279 — free cancellation before Dec 11, 2027, pay the property before arrival.
• Cheaper 4-person option: Ocean View with Queen and Double (one room, sea view) — AUD 1,760.40 direct / AUD 1,733 Booking.com.
• Not booked.

blocks.title: Unpack, showers, rest in the room
blocks.detail:
• 90 min: bags open, showers, fresh clothes, feet up.
• Kids: quiet time on the beds — keep them awake (no naps) so they sleep tonight.
• Curtains open for daylight — helps reset body clocks.

blocks.title: Walk around Huskisson — Whitesands Park beach, Currambene Creek, the wharf
blocks.detail:
• From: motel → along Owen St to Huskisson Whitesands Park and the beach (~200 m, 3 min) — paddle in the calm bay water (~70°F in December, range ~64–74°F).
• Then along the foreshore to the Currambene Creek bridge and Huskisson wharf, where the dolphin cruises leave.
• Ends at the shops on Owen St.
• Daylight and fresh air keep everyone awake until bedtime.

blocks.title: Breakfast groceries — Friendly Grocer Huskisson
blocks.detail:
• Friendly Grocer Huskisson, 66 Owen St — open to 7 PM Saturdays.
• Cereal, milk, yogurt, fruit, bread for 5 kitchenette breakfasts.
• Backup: Woolworths Vincentia (5 min drive) first thing Sunday.
• Then walk the groceries back to the motel (~250 m, 4 min).

blocks.title: Groceries into the room, then walk to the Huskisson Hotel
blocks.detail:
• From: Friendly Grocer → back to the motel (~250 m, 4 min); groceries into the bar fridge.
• Then: motel, 41 Owen St → east along Owen St.
• To: Huskisson Hotel, 75 Owen St — ~450 m, 8 min.

blocks.title: Dinner — Huskisson Hotel ("Husky Pub") bistro
blocks.detail:
• The town pub on the water: big wrap-around deck over Currambene Creek and the bay.
• Bistro dinner 5–8:30 PM; book a deck table online (NowBookIt) or call 02 4441 5001.
• Kids' meals include a juice.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Sept–Dec 2026):
• Husky Burger AUD 23 + Fish & Chips AUD 29
• 2 kids' meals AUD 14 each (tenders, battered fish, kids burger, steak)
• = AUD 80 ≈ USD 52.
• Saturday: no surcharge (Sundays +10%, public holidays +15%).
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Walk back to Jervis Bay Motel
blocks.detail:
• From: Huskisson Hotel, 75 Owen St → west along Owen St.
• To: Jervis Bay Motel, 41 Owen St — ~450 m, 8 min. Groceries into the bar fridge.

blocks.title: Pajamas, teeth — lights out 7:30
blocks.detail:
• Wind down; everyone in bed by 7:30 — first night after the long flight.
• Sunday breakfast in the room at 7:30 AM (12 hrs later).

days.title: Booderee National Park — Green Patch, Murrays Beach

blocks.title: Breakfast in the room — Jervis Bay Motel kitchenette
Drive to Booderee National Park (Green Patch)
blocks.detail: ~20 min; park entry fee per vehicle at the gate.

blocks.title: Green Patch — kangaroos on the beach, calm-water swim (anchor)
blocks.detail: Flat, clear, protected water; the kangaroos graze on the grass behind the sand in the morning.

blocks.title: Murrays Beach + Cave Beach lookout
blocks.detail: 10 min further into the park; Murrays is the glassy one.

days.title: Dolphin cruise + kayaks on the bay

blocks.title: Breakfast in the apartment, walk to the wharf
Dolphin cruise from Huskisson wharf (anchor)
blocks.detail: Jervis Bay's resident bottlenose pod; ~2 hrs; morning departures are calmest. Book ahead.

blocks.title: Kayak / SUP hire at Huskisson
blocks.detail: Double kayaks with a kid in front; the bay is flat in the afternoon lee.

blocks.title: Drive to Bendalong Boat Harbour
blocks.detail: ~45 min south.

blocks.title: Bendalong — wild stingrays in the shallows (anchor)
blocks.detail: The rays come into the boat-harbour shallows; kids stand ankle-deep beside them. Wild, unfenced — an adult per kid.

days.title: Hyams Beach early, Huskisson free day

blocks.title: Drive to Hyams Beach
blocks.detail: Parking is gone by 9 AM in December — this is why it's the early one.

blocks.title: Hyams Beach — the white sand (anchor)
blocks.detail: Squeaky white quartz sand, clear water, gentle; the postcard beach of the bay.

blocks.title: Huskisson — wharf, ice cream, pack for tomorrow
Apartment / beach downtime — buffer day
blocks.detail: Deliberately empty: the weather-swap day for the dolphin cruise or Bendalong if either got rained out.

days.title: Fitzroy Falls, then the long drive north to Port Stephens

blocks.title: Drive Huskisson → Fitzroy Falls via Kangaroo Valley
blocks.detail: ~75 min through the valley.

blocks.title: Fitzroy Falls — boardwalk to the lookout
blocks.detail: Easy, flat, 20 min each way; 81 m waterfall.

blocks.title: Drive Fitzroy Falls → Port Stephens
blocks.detail:
Hume Hwy → M7/M2 Sydney bypass → M1 north → Port Stephens. ~300 km, 3h45 clear; 4h30 allowed with a lunch stop.
The loop's one long day.

blocks.title: Check in — Oaks Pacific Blue, Salamander Bay (5 nights)
blocks.detail: Lagoon pool, apartments, the family pick. The Anchorage (Corlette) is the boutique-luxury alternative.
blocks.flag: Placeholder — book the resort AND its Christmas Day lunch now; no Hyatt/Marriott/Hilton in Port Stephens.

days.title: Tomaree Head + Shoal Bay — Christmas Eve

blocks.title: Drive to the Tomaree Head trailhead, Shoal Bay
Tomaree Head summit walk (anchor)
blocks.detail: 1.5 km each way, steep with steps, 40 min up at kid pace; the view over the whole bay and the islands.

blocks.title: Shoal Bay — flat, calm swimming
blocks.detail: Harbour-calm; the kids swim without flags.

blocks.title: Resort downtime; 4WD delivered for tomorrow (placeholder)
blocks.detail: One-day 4WD hire from a Port Stephens/Newcastle operator, delivered to the resort — to be researched; Worimi permit bought online.

days.title: Christmas Day — Stockton dunes beach drive

blocks.title: Drive to the Lavis Lane / Anna Bay beach entry
Stockton Beach & Worimi dunes — 4WD, sandboarding, Tin City (anchor)
blocks.detail:
19 km of beach plus the dune recreation area; sandboards from the car.
Tide window from the BOM 2027 Newcastle table — avoid an hour either side of high water; if Christmas Day's tide is wrong, swap this with Dec 26 or 27.

blocks.title: Pool / Fingal Spit walk at low tide

days.title: Myall Lakes — Bombah Point ferry, Mungo Brush, Seal Rocks

blocks.title: Drive to Bombah Point via Tea Gardens
Bombah Point car ferry across Myall Lake
blocks.detail: Cable ferry, every ~30 min.

blocks.title: Mungo Brush — lakeside swim and rainforest walk (anchor)
blocks.detail: Freshwater lake, paperbarks, the 2 km Mungo rainforest loop.

blocks.title: Sugarloaf Point lighthouse walk + Number One Beach
blocks.detail: Short steep walk to the lighthouse; sheltered swim below.

blocks.title: Drive back to the resort
blocks.detail: ~1h45 via the Pacific Hwy.

days.title: Fingal Bay + Nelson Bay — last Port Stephens day

blocks.title: Fingal Bay — calm swim, Fingal Spit at low tide

days.title: Drive to Sydney — check in for NYE week

blocks.title: Drive Port Stephens → Sydney
blocks.detail: ~215 km via the M1, 2h30 clear; 2h45 allowed.

blocks.title: Return the rental — Sydney (airport or CBD branch)
blocks.detail: No car in Sydney; ferries and trains from here.

blocks.title: Check in — Park Hyatt Sydney (5 nights)
blocks.detail: Globalist award stay; Opera House-facing rooms for the fireworks.
blocks.flag: NYE nights carry minimum stays and the highest award levels of the year — book the moment Dec 2027 opens (~13 months out).

blocks.title: Ferry Circular Quay → Manly
blocks.detail: 30 min across the Heads — the best ride in the city.

days.title: Sydney — Bondi to Bronte, harbour afternoon

blocks.title: Bondi Beach + the coastal walk to Bronte (anchor)
blocks.detail: Icebergs pool at one end, Bronte's ocean pool at the other; 2.5 km, flat-ish, kid-friendly.

blocks.title: Royal Botanic Garden + Mrs Macquarie's Chair
blocks.detail: Scout the fireworks sightlines.

blocks.title: Opera House forecourt + Circular Quay before the closures
Hotel — rest before the long night
Dinner + the 9 PM family fireworks
blocks.detail: From the hotel or a ticketed vantage point (Royal Botanic Garden / harbour cruise) — booked months out.

blocks.title: Midnight fireworks
blocks.detail: Kids' call: stay up for midnight from the room, or sleep after the 9 PM show.

days.title: New Year's Day — slow harbour day

blocks.title: Hotel pool / Barangaroo Reserve playground and foreshore
blocks.detail: Everything else is shut or hungover; the harbour foreshore and the pool are the day.

blocks.title: Ferry ride to Watsons Bay and back — the last harbour view
Fly SYD → home (placeholder)
blocks.detail: US nonstops depart Sydney early afternoon; arrives the same calendar day in the US.

items.name: What this file is
items.note: Outline-level alternative to V1 (Brisbane/Noosa). Days, drive times and anchors are set; hotels, meals and prices are placeholders to be researched if this variant is chosen.

items.name: Flights
items.note: Modeled on a real AA search: AA2290 MIA 6:15 PM → LAX 8:46 PM, 2h09m connection, AA73 LAX 10:55 PM → SYD 7:05 AM (+2 days), 22h50m total; 65,000 Atmos pts + $48 per person = 260,000 + $192. Confirm Dec 16, 2027 times when award inventory opens (~Dec 2026–Jan 2027).

items.name: Tides — Stockton Beach (Newcastle reference port)
items.note: Pick the beach-driving day from the BOM 2027 Newcastle table the same way Noosa was done (low tide mid-morning). Worimi beach permit AUD 33 / 3 days, online only.

items.name: Christmas week bookings
items.note: Port Stephens resort + its Christmas Day lunch, Jervis Bay Motel Deluxe Family Room (Dec 18–23), Park Hyatt NYE nights (minimum stays likely), NYE fireworks vantage tickets — all book out months ahead.

items.name: Rental car
items.note: Large SUV (Kluger/Sorento/Santa Fe/Everest) or Kia Carnival — must take 3 checked bags + carry-on + 3 backpacks. SYD T1 pickup Dec 18 ~9:10 AM, returned in Sydney Dec 28 (10 days, ~AUD 1,700 est.). Book free-cancellation now; this class sells out at Christmas.

items.name: Grand Pacific Drive — moved off Dec 18
items.note: Royal National Park (AUD 12/car), Bald Hill Lookout, Sea Cliff Bridge walk and Kiama Blowhole were dropped from arrival day so check-in is ~2 PM. Candidate day: Dec 23 drive north to Port Stephens (Kiama → Sea Cliff Bridge → Bald Hill → Royal NP → Sydney) instead of Fitzroy Falls / Kangaroo Valley — adds ~1.5 hrs to an already long drive. Not yet planned.

items.name: Repeats
items.note: Dolphins only in Jervis Bay; beach driving and dunes only in Port Stephens; one calm-bay day and one big-nature day in each base.
